summary: Geometry, LOD, collision, socket, bounds and naming gates all pass on the exported bytes: gun 34,180/15,350/5,078/2,474 (45%/15%, strictly descending), 10+1+3 UCX hulls with 0 of 29.7M samples outside, 20+5+5 sockets in sidecars at <=0.0004 mm, bounds extension recorded, textures square power-of-two with 16-bit normals, and no deny-list or real brand hit in any file or sidecar. The release gaps are packaging and verification, not geometry: there is no README.md or MATERIALS_README.md in Exports/Guns/SR01, no Unreal import gate exists for SR01 (W5 not run), and the pack material instances (W6) are not built. Several W2 texture gates were recorded as declared near-misses (B9 uniformity, FAKE-looking realism judges, S/F marking not painted) that a buyer could notice. Budget floors (gun, mag, scope) are under target but inside ceilings and declared.

findings.evidence: Exports/Guns/SR01 holds no README.md and no MATERIALS_README.md (SMG01 has both). No Textures/Recolour/recolour_constants.json either: only recolour_maps.json (master M_Fabric_Master, colour_linear 0.08326/0.08521/0.06093, detail16 2048).
findings.suggested_fix: Write README.md on the SMG01 model: file table (SK + LOD1-3 tris 34,180/15,350/5,078/2,474; SM_SR01 35,058/15,744/5,230/2,552 with 10 hulls UCX_SM_SR01_LOD0_00..09; SM_SR01_Mag 878/394/152/78 with 1 hull; SM_Att_Scope_LongRange 5,884/2,640/846 with 3 hulls; 8 clips with fps/frames; Physics proxy). Import steps: Import Normals, Convert Scene, Force Front X off, no physics asset at import, import_lod for LOD1-3, LOD screen sizes SK 1/0.27303/0.07165/0.03604, SM_SR01 1/0.25/0.06561/0.033, Mag 1/0.03448/0.00905/0.00455, scope 1/0.09518/0.02498. Bone compression DefaultRecorderBoneCompression and why. Notifies table from the sidecar. Bounds extension (+0/8.681/2.407, -0/12.877/18.394 cm). Safety held at FIRE in Fire/BoltCycle/ReloadEmpty. Bipod states and 12 deg leg splay, cheek riser. Scope mount (Rail_Top + 2 slots = 20.02 mm; Sight/EyePoint are the aim sockets; the gun has no Sight socket). Socket lists (20 gun, 5 mag, 5 scope). Mag straight reload path 67.8 mm. Collision and in-hand advice, mass 5.9 kg and CoM. Texture table with colour-space and compression settings. FP FirstPerson + ForcedLodModel=1. Shared-skeleton note. 'Not tested yet' list. Write MATERIALS_README.md after W6 (MI_SR01_Metal on M_Steel_Master, MI_SR01_Chassis on M_Fabric_Master with Colour + Use Original Baked Colours off, MI_SR01_Mag, scope instances).

findings.evidence: WorkFiles/guns/sniper/gates contains no Unreal-run gate; every pass is a Blender re-import of the exported bytes. Plan items U5 (engine bounds / sphere radius), U7 (dropped-gun runtime bounds with the PHYS_SR01 envelope box), U9 (notifies, clip fidelity) and the hull/socket/LOD-size import are unmeasured. game.json B11 says 'U5 re-checks in engine'.
findings.suggested_fix: Run the W5 Unreal pass in a fresh process on the exact bytes (sha256 are recorded in rig_export.json, mag.json, scope_export.json) before any README claim of 'checked in Unreal'. README must say 'not tested yet' until then.

findings.area: Texture quality as shipped (declared W2 items)
findings.evidence: uv_bake_paint.json status 'partial': B9 uniformity failed for Metal class C (P5 31.3 vs 31.5 needed) and scope Scope_Body class C (40.9 vs 41.1); realism judges FAKE 7/7 (judge A) and FAKE 7/7 (judge B) on the textured renders, geometry tells deferred to W4b; one declared line says the S / F stamp painted 0 texels and 'not delivered in W2', while the paint report row shows markings_texels 109 on Chassis; declared UD2 3/4/0 and 8 UD3 zero-tangent corners 'must be 0 before the W3 export' (later gate rows in the same file show UD2 0/0/0 and UD3 0, so the declared list is stale). Texture files in git status are modified after this report.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm the B9 near-misses were fixed (per-island scale normalisation) or accept them in the README; re-run realism judges after W4b; reconcile the declared list with the final gates; state in the README whether the generic S/F marking ships. Re-read the final paint_report.

findings.evidence: game.json B8: gun LOD0 34,180 below the plan's 35k floor (35,058 with the merged mag); mag LOD0 878 vs 2-3k target (mag.json); scope LOD0 5,884 vs 6-10k target (scope_export.json). LOD1 44.9%, LOD2 14.9%, LOD3 2,474 inside the 2-3k band; all strictly descending; all under the 50k/5k/12k ceilings. LOD-pop gate passes (mean <=0.107 px, max 2.5 px at 2560x1440).
findings.suggested_fix: None needed; record as accepted deviations in the README (SMG review item n2 precedent).

findings.evidence: game.json: UV1 overlaps collapsed by the qa rule on coarse LODs (LOD1 2,514, LOD2 1,194, LOD3 586). uv_bake_paint.json UD4: collapsed_triangles 20,020 (gun, 34k tris) and 2,292 (scope, 5.9k tris) at 64 and 128 px, 0 shared texels and 0 padding violations. rig_export.json B2 note: coarse-LOD UV0 slivers 'opened by 4e-6 UV' (LOD1 79, LOD2 116, LOD3 69).
findings.suggested_fix: README: use authored UV1 with Generate Lightmap UVs off, LightMapResolution <=128 (SMG n3 precedent: the engine showed overlaps at 1024); measure in engine at W5.

findings.evidence: All 21 PNGs carry no gAMA/sRGB/iCCP chunk. Normal maps are 16-bit RGB (bit depth 16, colour type 2), Masks RGBA, ORM RGB, Detail16 16-bit grey. Sizes: Metal 2048 (Masks 1024), Chassis 4096 (Masks 2048), Mag 1024 (Masks 512), Scope_Body 2048 (Masks 1024), Scope_Lens 512 (Masks 256): all square power of two. Names follow T_<Asset>_<Set>_<Map>; the scope names double 'Scope' (T_Att_Scope_LongRange_Scope_Body_BC). BC sRGB / ORM linear / N DirectX is only stated in the gate notes, not in any shipped file.
findings.suggested_fix: README must state BC sRGB; ORM and Masks linear; N DirectX with Normalmap compression; Detail16 G16 grayscale; BC7 for the polymer BC as in the SMG README. Optional cosmetic: shorten the scope set names.

findings.area: Magazine hull name not re-verified on the export
findings.evidence: mag.json hull gate lists 'UCX_SM_SR01_Mag_00' (no LOD0); the rule for a LOD group is UCX_<base>_LOD0_NN (SMG ships UCX_SM_SMG01_Mag_LOD0_00). game.json C1 prints the twin hulls as 'UCX_SM_SR01_00' but its re-import row shows 'UCX_SM_SR01_LOD0_00..09' (correct). mag.json has no re-import name row (only M7/M9 sidecar rows); scope_export.json does confirm UCX_SM_Att_Scope_LongRange_LOD0_00..02.
findings.suggested_fix: One re-import name check on SM_SR01_Mag.fbx to confirm UCX_SM_SR01_Mag_LOD0_00; fix the gate label.

findings.evidence: SK_SR01.skeletal.json compatible_skeletons ['SK_AR01_Skeleton']; rig_export/game gate: gunlib's own parent table rejects 'cheek_riser<-body' (proposal P1, validated with a sniper-side table); SR01 adds bipod, bipod_leg_*, cheek_riser and has no stock bone. Unreal compatibility is untested.
findings.suggested_fix: README: say the shared Anim Blueprint will warn on bones missing from either skeleton (SMG README precedent) and that SR01-only bones are driven by clips; verify in W5.
